dividend_mode.ACCRUE_PER_TOKEN: Dividend reinvested; balance unchanged, each token represents more shares (token price drifts above the stock)
dividend_mode.UNVERIFIED: Payout status of underlying not confirmed

notes: All reinvested dividends are net of up to 30% US withholding.

issuers.name: xStocks
issuers.legal_form: Tracker certificate (bearer debt) from a bankruptcy-remote SPV
issuers.custody: Alpaca Securities (FINRA, SIPC member) plus InCore Bank; Lloyd's cover up to $175M aggregate
issuers.verification: Weekly on-chain proof of reserves, quarterly ISAE 3000 audits, independent security agent
issuers.dividends: Reinvested: your token balance rebases upward (net of withholding)
issuers.fees: Kraken charges its own spot fee; on-chain you pay only DEX price impact plus Jupiter's 2–10 bps
issuers.access: Trades permissionlessly 24/7 on DEXs. Mint/redeem 24/5 for KYC'd non-US clients only
issuers.catch: An independent review (Pine Analytics) found the terms allow collateral that isn't always the underlying share, so you carry Backed's credit risk. Liquidity on Solana is deep for only about a dozen names.
issuers.liquidity_model: AMM pools (Raydium, Byreal, Riptide…) via Jupiter
issuers.protection_summary: Shares held in a separate bankruptcy-remote company with regular audits and weekly proof of reserves. An independent review found its terms allow the backing to not always be the actual shares, so holders carry some risk tied to xStocks itself.
issuers.address_source: xStocks public API: https://api.xstocks.fi/api/v2/public/assets (Solana mints start with 'Xs')
issuers.catalog_size_note: 869 deployments across chains on CoinGecko; deep Solana liquidity on ~a dozen names

issuers.name: Ondo
issuers.legal_form: Structured note from a bankruptcy-remote SPV with an independent director
issuers.custody: US broker-dealers; 1:1 backing plus an overcollateralization buffer
issuers.verification: Daily attestations by Ankura Trust; security agent holds a first-priority claim and can liquidate the collateral for holders on default
issuers.dividends: Reinvested: each token represents more shares over time (net of withholding)
issuers.fees: No mint or burn fees and a $1 minimum; the cost is built into the quoted price
issuers.access: Mint/redeem for whitelisted non-US wallets. On Jupiter it trades via RFQ, 24/5; the top six (SPY, QQQ, CRCL, NVDA, TSLA, GOOGL) mint 24/7
issuers.catch: Liquidity is just-in-time rather than pooled, so weekends and nights get wide spreads. Mostly US names.
issuers.liquidity_model: RFQ: just-in-time quotes from the real market; wider spreads outside US hours
issuers.protection_summary: Shares sit in a separate legal company protected if Ondo goes bankrupt. 1:1 backing plus a buffer, daily independent attestations (Ankura Trust), and a third-party security agent who can seize and sell the shares for holders on default.
issuers.address_source: Official token CSV linked from https://docs.ondo.finance/addresses
issuers.catalog_size_note: 457 tokens on CoinGecko (~200+ distinct on Solana)
issuers.fees_note: No mint or redeem fees; $1 minimum

issuers.name: Backpack
issuers.full_name: Backpack Securities (listed on Solana via Sunrise)
issuers.legal_form: Tokenized shares from a registered US broker-dealer; each token backed 1:1 by a real share in custody and redeemable for the underlying
issuers.verification: Broker-dealer custody; Sunrise sets up the official Solana addresses and trading pools
issuers.dividends: Reinvested: dividends arrive as extra tokens
issuers.fees: Trading fees waived through July 2026; current fees not published in what I found
issuers.access: 'Eligible users' outside the US; wallets can hold and transfer them, but whether every user can withdraw to any wallet is unclear
issuers.catch: Biggest catalog of any issuer (~1,000 US stocks and ETFs, 10,000 planned), but newer, and self-custody access for non-US users needs confirming. Many tokens still have thin or no on-chain trading.
issuers.protection_summary: Real shares held 1:1 by a US broker-dealer, redeemable for the underlying stock. Newer; self-custody withdrawal for all non-US users not confirmed.
issuers.address_source: Backpack / Sunrise directly (copycats share the plain ticker)
issuers.catalog_size_note: ~1,000 US stocks and ETFs on the platform, 10,000 planned; ~65 on CoinGecko
issuers.fees_note: Trading fees waived through July 2026; current fees unpublished

issuers.custody: SPVs; backing disputed in some cases
issuers.dividends: None. Private companies, and the tokens explicitly carry no dividend, voting or information rights
issuers.fees: 1% transfer fee on every transfer; redemption needs KYC, a minimum size and a processing fee

issuers.fees_note: 1% on every transfer; redemption needs KYC, minimum size and a fee
